The schema block is the editor

2026-09-04

A section declares what can be changed about it, and nothing else can be:

{
  "name": "Hero",
  "settings": [
    { "id": "heading", "type": "text", "label": "Heading" },
    { "id": "padding", "type": "range", "label": "Padding", "min": 32, "max": 200 }
  ]
}

That JSON has two readers. Liqx type-checks a template's props against it at render time; Pillar reads the same block as the dashboard's control manifest. One contract, written once, in the file the section already lives in.

The catch is that the two halves of a field type — the PHP cast and the editor control — can drift apart, and when they do a section stops parsing entirely. So both are generated from schema/field-types.json, and CI fails if either is stale.
